t.E504.agn: In 1965, JECFA set the ADI for magnesium carbonate as 'not limited'; in 1979 it decided that a numerical ADI was not necessary ('not specified') for magnesium hydroxide carbonate. In the EU, as a Group I additive, it may be used at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E504.found.0: May be used at quantum satis (as much as needed) in many foods in the EU
t.E504.prod: It is produced chemically by adding carbonate to a magnesium sulphate solution or by carbonating magnesium hydroxide.
t.E504.regx.1: ADI 'not specified' for magnesium hydroxide carbonate.
t.E504.regx.2: Group I additive; generally permitted at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E504.summary: Magnesium carbonates. Used as an anti-caking agent and acidity regulator.
t.E504.what: Magnesium carbonate and magnesium hydroxide carbonate; used as an anti-caking agent, acidity regulator and carrier.
